title: Graph correspondence
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber] and the coefficient conventions [def-trf-coefficient-conventions], writing $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$ and $A=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$. Let $X$ be the separated finite-type $k$-scheme in those conventions [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], let $h:X\to X$ be a separated finite-type $k$-endomorphism, let $K\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$, and let $v:Lh^*K\to K$, with derived pullback as in [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. The *graph correspondence* of $(h,v)$ is the cohomological correspondence [def-trf-correspondence] with
$$
C=X,\qquad c=(\operatorname{id}_X,h):X\longrightarrow X\times_sX,\qquad c_1=\operatorname{id}_X,\qquad c_2=h,
$$
and coefficient morphism $u=\iota_{X,K}\circ v:Lh^*K\to R(\operatorname{id}_X)^!K$, where $R(\operatorname{id}_X)^!$ is the constructible exceptional inverse image of [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. Define $\iota_{X,K}:K\xrightarrow{\sim}R(\operatorname{id}_X)^!K$ to be the unit of the constructible adjunction $R(\operatorname{id}_X)_!\dashv R(\operatorname{id}_X)^!$ of [def-trf-admissibility], transported along the canonical identification $R(\operatorname{id}_X)_!\cong\operatorname{id}$ obtained by taking the compactification $(j,\bar f)=(\operatorname{id}_X,\operatorname{id}_X)$ in [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed]. Thus the source notation $u=v$ uses this identification. The map $c$ is the fibre-product morphism with the displayed projections, using [def-pc-fibre-product]. Its fixed scheme, by [def-trf-fixed-scheme], is
$$
\operatorname{Fix}(c)=\operatorname{Fix}(h):=X\times_{X\times_sX,(\operatorname{id}_X,h),\Delta_X}X,
$$
the scheme-theoretic equalizer of $h$ and $\operatorname{id}_X$.

note: *Recorded in advance* from chapter *The trace formula* of the source.

proof.text: For trfGraphOrigin, discard the finite-Tor conjunct. The finite set of nonzero intrinsic cohomology degrees is bounded above and below, giving boundedness. Transport this through the exact canonical scalar equivalence. Its homology comparison, followed by intrinsicRealization_restriction and proEtaleModuleRestriction_constructible_iff, makes every fixed-scalar cohomology sheaf constructible. Apply the fixed-module bounded-constructible origin theorem and then boundedConstructible.plusEtaleOrigin. This works for zero objects and empty schemes without needing l different from the characteristic.

For trfGraphIdentityBoundedBelow, use the canonical compactification instance and quasi-compactness of X over Spec k to obtain CompactSpace X. The finite-coefficient ordinary etale upper-shriek bounded-below instance then applies to the identity.

Restrict the published exceptional Hom equivalence to the full bounded-below etale-origin category, obtaining its actual adjunction. The canonical originCompactSupportId identifies its left functor with the identity, so that left functor is an equivalence and the adjunction unit is invertible. The transpose of the identity comparison is the unit followed by the right functor applied to that comparison, hence is invertible. Applying the full-subcategory inclusion and unfolding mkOfHomEquiv identifies this transpose exactly with trfGraphIdentityMap; no arbitrary adjunction or identity comparison is used.

The graph data retain C=X, c1=id, c2=h and coefficient v followed by the proved identity exceptional isomorphism. Its toProduct map is definitionally trfFixedGraphMap, including proof irrelevance of the commuting-square proof. Thus the two fixed schemes are the identical chosen pullback, and trfGraphCorrespondence_fixedScheme is rfl. This preserves the full scheme structure for arbitrary h and v.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-NR-ba2df0853 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the item, all 10 nodes its statement depends on (statement and blueprint_update), the blueprint source in both main-20261015 (order 2432) and master (order 2088), which have the same text, the unit record and the item's citers. The hypotheses match the source exactly: X is the geometric fibre from the coefficient conventions, h is a separated finite-type k-endomorphism, K is in D^b_ctf, v is arbitrary, c1=id is the exceptional leg and c2=h the ordinary one, and Fix(c)=Fix(h) is used as def-trf-fixed-scheme defines it. Nothing is added or dropped. The only real change is writing the source's u=v as u=iota∘v. This is a necessary typing step, because R(id)^! = nu^* id^× Rnu_* is not literally the identity. I checked that iota is well defined and invertible: iota = G(alpha)∘eta, where alpha: R(id)_! ≅ id comes from the compactification (id,id), and the triangle identities of def-trf-admissibility plus naturality show iota is an isomorphism. This is elementary inside the definition. It also fits every citer: prop-trf-graph-operator step 1 cancels the counit through the first triangle identity, and def-trf-frobenius-coefficient-morphism reads the identification through this same canonical iso. Small cases tested: h=id (Fix=X with its nilpotents), translation on A^1 (empty fixed scheme), empty X, K=0, v=0, Frobenius iterates, and the equalizer checked on arbitrary test schemes T. No duplicate exists: def-trf-correspondence-between-pairs is the general notion. There are no new nodes. All dependencies are definitions, so the unit route is not affected and no tool_uses were accepted. The three kinds of Mathlib search are recorded, and the invalid Loogle query is honestly marked invalid. Two small faults fixed in fixes/dag/nodes/sec-six-functors/def-trf-graph-correspondence.json: (1) B4, the statement's final math was never closed ('$\operatorname{id}_X.' changed to '$\operatorname{id}_X$.'); (2) the notation '(j,p)' became 'the compactification (j,\bar f)', matching def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed.
